title: Auto MPG：六输入的原生 origin 组留出
question: 固定线性 Ridge 在原生 origin 组留出时是否优于训练折均值参考？父子差值另用严格保存预测对照，判定 model_year 的本次误差贡献。
claim: The fixed Ridge model has lower merged origin-held-out OOF MAE than its corresponding training-fold target mean reference.
alternatives: Model-year information may change this fixed protocol's saved errors; that change is not a causal effect or a future-year validation.
Unequal origin groups alter training sizes and contribute unequally to pooled MAE; native group labels do not establish sampling independence.
Either fixed linear feature set may miss nonlinear relationships; no tuning, extra algorithms or new data are authorized by this design.
change_reason: Prespecified six-feature parent on native origin codes; no result-dependent protocol changes.
